purpose: Independently judge the candidate against the original request, scoped check and affected contracts; report blockers without repairing.

execution.instructions: Read the original request, accepted plan/card manifest, retained patch and full scoped check/measurement artifacts. Verify every card condition; internal pins are unreviewed. Follow AGENTS.md and docs/testing.md. Inspect only affected source/contracts for completeness, correctness, public behavior, generated ownership, unnecessary work and meaningful test purpose/placement. Source is read-only: do not edit, retest, use Git, launch agents or perform external work. Require complete structured request/seed/phase/work evidence for every authorized case. Missing selected tests, incomplete/skipped execution, missing sidecars or truncated stdout are not acceptance; evidence_status alone is not completeness. Compare full before/current records and preserve negative samples. Changed seeds, environments or instrumentation are not matched comparisons. Pristine baseline_measurements proves only its selected controls: missing cases/lost historical seeds cannot prove matched replay or the original timeout fixed. A failed baseline is failure evidence, never timing success. Require a supported cause and unchanged meaningful acceptance, including native/New benefit where requested. Preserve correctness, uniqueness/grade, identity/replay/saves, ordering, cancellation and all work/time/memory/security bounds. Keep immutable first-candidate before_measurements distinct from pristine baseline and matched instrumented controls. Canonical runner-measure-history-v1 is final current measurement evidence: parse every ordered entry's exact measurement JSON, including latest/intermediate reports and bindings. Choose matched before/current by source, instrumentation, protocol, runtime and seeds, never round alone. Source narrative must be truthful as-of supplied reports and cite canonical history; do not demand its own future measurement/hash. Never omit entries, waive unsupported claims or dump the bundle. Only for a bundle from fixed configured runner-measure-history --source {workspace}, verify last-entry source_bindings: measurement_sha256 equals entry.sha256 and SHA256(exact measurement JSON bytes); source equals entry.source in identity, sha256, digestMethod, files and bytes. Its fresh snapshot/drift check proves current-source identity without model rehash/retest, not fresh checks, matched seeds, timeout resolution or domain acceptance. Only fixed configured current-check prepared_input may bind checks to prepared patch: require input_verified=true; verify source_base, input_patch_id, input_patch_sha256, input_patch_bytes and runtime.go_version/goos/goarch. Match supplied patch bytes/hash when available. This proves prepared input, not a whole-source digest, measurement identity or approval. Retained FromInput checks, including initial unchanged-source review, remain old context requiring verified producer/source provenance, not fresh execution or qualification by label. All original domain obligations, packaging, runtime/browser qualification and protected release gates remain. Return ready with verdict exactly APPROVE only for a complete source handoff with sufficient focused proof. In-scope repair returns changes_requested with verdict BLOCKED. Missing capability, infrastructure uncertainty or a required material decision returns blocked. Do not waive proof or widen scope. Summary <=240 characters: concrete blockers/missing proof, no timing/fix claims from incomparable reports.
